rules: Population is a single aggregate number for the capital — there is no per-citizen profession assignment.
Buildings (Part02) produce their stated yield directly, regardless of population size.

Recruiting N warriors immediately reduces population by N — capped so population never drops below 1. This is a temporary dip, not a permanent loss: it recovers over subsequent turns through normal growth once food income is positive.
Population never goes below 1 in the player's capital while the game is active.

growth.rule: Population grows when food income exceeds food consumption.
growth.growth_chance_formula: min(food_surplus / 20, 0.5) chance per turn to add 1 new citizen

happiness_interaction.rule: Happiness below 50% reduces all production by a percentage; happiness below 25% risks unrest events.
